catalogo.titulo: Understand the economy you're already reading about
catalogo.claim: Short modules, written by the same newsroom that signs our reports. Each one opens with a free lesson, so you know what you're buying before you buy it.

claseAbierta.texto: Read it in full before paying anything. All it takes is an account with a verified email.

unPago.texto: No subscription, no automatic renewal. You buy the module and it's yours to keep.

sinCaducidad.texto: Once purchased, your access never expires. New lessons added to the module are included automatically.

abrir.texto: It's free and complete. All it asks for is an account with a verified email.

comprar.titulo: Buy the module if it works for you
comprar.texto: A single payment by card or Mercado Pago. The whole module unlocks instantly.

ritmo.texto: Your access never expires and stays saved in your account.

nivel.p: Do I need to know economics to get started?
nivel.r: No. Each module states its level, and beginner modules start from zero: every term is explained before it's used.

verAntes.p: Can I see something before paying?
verAntes.r: Yes. The first lesson of every module is open, and it's a complete lesson, not a preview or a table of contents.

pago.r: By card through Stripe, or with Mercado Pago where available. It's a one-time charge: nothing is set up as a recurring payment.

donde.p: Where do the modules I buy live?
donde.r: In your account. Sign in with the same email and they're available from any device, with no time limit.
